# PRD audit findings and completeness check

## Findings from the PRD v2 review

- **CONFLICT · Three different stacks across sources.** Architecture v2 (.NET), Build Plan (Vite + NestJS + AKS) and the October 2026 plan (Next.js 16 + App Service). Resolved in v2: .NET 10 + Azure SQL Database (sections 7 and 7b).
- **CHANGE · ERD and Build Plan assume PostgreSQL.** Map types before P0 ends: jsonb → json/nvarchar(max), exclusion constraint → unique slot index, RLS policies → SQL security predicates, money stays integer minor units. Update the Build Plan and Azure Architecture pages to match.
- **ADDED v2 · Requirements missing from every source.** Database security baseline, data classification, staff offboarding, legal and consent records, clinical safety case, security operations with breach notification, retention and deletion jobs. Added as P0-09, P0-10, P1-11, P1-12, P2-08, P5-11, P5-12.
- **ID CLASH · P-09 used for two screens.** Doctor revenue report and receipts/tax invoices share P-09 in the Foundations inventory, and P-10 to P-14 are listed twice. Receipts renumbered to P-15 here; update Foundations to match.
- **MISSING · No screens for SaaS operations.** Subscription billing for clinics (N-11) and a platform operations console with audited support access (N-12) are required to sell and support Medvya but appear in no source.
- **MISSING · Gap-analysis Musts without designs.** Migration and data-quality (N-04, N-05), Emirates ID reader (N-06), exchange status (N-07), patient-upload extraction (N-08), certificates and e-sick leave (N-09), voice assistant (N-10).
- **MISSING · Doctor discovery has no design.** The October plan lists public doctor profiles and discovery in the patient experience (N-02).
- **SEQUENCE · AI moved ahead of billing.** The October plan puts AI documentation in its Phase 3; the product’s landing promise and designs centre on it, so it pilots in P3 with 5–10 clinicians while billing follows in P4.
- **SEQUENCE · Market-specific Musts gate UAE, not India.** Exchange connection, Emirates ID and eClaimLink are UAE launch blockers. If India launches first, they move within P5 without delaying the first paying clinic.
- **CHECK · Inventory statuses.** P-01 and C-01 are marked “next” rather than hi-fi in Foundations; confirm final designs before P1 and P4 build respectively.
